summary: Bulk Demand Letter workflow (iter 54) tested end-to-end. 15/15 backend pytest cases pass (generate/list/bulk-email/backwards-compat). Frontend verified: /demand-letters page loads with 92 seeded rows, stat tiles populated (total=92 emailed=2 pending=90), row selection reveals bulk-toolbar, generate-bulk-btn visible for admin, hidden for sales, sidebar entry visible for admin only. PaymentStageCard AlertDialog fires after stage change with correct Generate/Skip buttons. Customer-missing isolation verified with a seeded row in mongo (status='failed', emailed_at not set).

minor.issue: 'missing stage' 400 path is only reachable if the settings doc is fully absent or current_stage=''. The set_current_stage endpoint enforces non-empty stage, so this branch cannot be triggered via public API. The code branch itself is correct; just note that testers must delete the settings doc directly in mongo to exercise it.

integration_issues.issue: Page renders but the initial GET /api/documents/demand-letters returns 403 (role gated to admin/manager/accounts) producing an 'Insufficient permissions' toast. Buttons are correctly hidden but the failed fetch still fires. Consider guarding the fetch client-side on the same role list as the sidebar, or return an empty list with 200 for non-privileged roles.

action_items: Optional: silence the 403 toast for sales users on /demand-letters by short-circuiting the fetch when role not in [admin,manager,accounts] (or route-guard the page in App.js).
Optional: add a hard 400 in generate-bulk endpoint when PAYMENT_STAGES lookup returns None to strengthen the 'unknown stage key' branch (already present, no change needed).
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering fix for /documents/demand-letters (declared BEFORE /documents/{customer_id}) is correct and verified.
bulk-email endpoint correctly persists status/emailed_at even on failure, preventing infinite retry loops.
GeneratedDocument model backwards-compat is safe: new fields default to None and single-doc POST /documents/generate is unaffected (verified for demand_letter, sales_agreement, allotment_letter).
Idempotence works via {customer_id, doc_type, stage_key} uniqueness lookup; the batch_id is intentionally regenerated on each call which is correct per spec.
_resend_send mocked-fallback path treats 'mocked' as success and stamps emailed_at, matching spec.
seed_data_creation: Test suite triggered a bulk-generate that created ~90 demand-letter records for stage_key='podium'. Ephemeral mongo-seeded row for the customer-missing isolation test was deleted immediately after verification. Payment stage was restored to 'podium' at end of testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk demand letter feature is stable. /demand-letters lists 90+ podium letters; 2 are already marked emailed from this test run. Payment stage in settings is 'podium'. If retesting, expect idempotent 0/skipped on repeat bulk-generate. Sales user gets a 403 toast on page load — a known non-blocking UX nit noted in integration_issues.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug reproduced; feature works as specified.
